title: Crashing Waves and Sea Spray, Rocky Coastline - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A dramatic black-and-white landscape snapshot depicting ocean waves vigorously churning and crashing against a dark, rugged rocky headland. White sea foam blankets the foreground waters against the jagged shoreline beneath an open sky and distant ocean horizon. The photograph features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-20th-century amateur photography.
